title: Selected Topics in Mathematics; Advanced Linear Optimization
description:
Prerequisite: Math 423

Post-optimality analysis, integer programming, goal program ming, the revised simplex method, the Karmarkar algorithm, bounded variables problems, sequencing problems (processing n jobs through two or k machines, and processing two jobs through k machines), scheduling using the Program Evaluation and Review Technique (PERT) and the Critical PathMethod (CPM), and dynamic programming
